name: Multiplayer Edit
description: Collaborate with friends in real-time level editing! TURN/UDP test build for self-hosted relay.

signaling-url.name: Signaling Server URL
signaling-url.description: URL of the signaling server used for connection setup.

turn-host.name: TURN Host
turn-host.description: Hostname or IPv4 address of the TURN server. Port 3478/UDP is used by this test build.

turn-password.name: TURN Password
turn-password.description: TURN password. Stored only in your local Geode settings; do not publish it.

force-turn-relay.name: Force TURN Relay
force-turn-relay.description: Force all WebRTC ICE traffic through TURN. Keep enabled for the diagnostic test; disable later to allow direct P2P with TURN fallback.

player-name.name: Player Name
player-name.description: Your display name in multiplayer sessions.

show-cursors.name: Show Player Cursors
show-cursors.description: Display other players' cursor positions in the editor.
